verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say publishing creates a production deployment that runs at its own URL, with public, password-protected or invite-only access options. The docs describe this as a simplified process, and the template flow ends in 'publish a live URL'. Built-in hosting, a default replit.app subdomain, custom domains and post-launch monitoring are also documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that publishing is literally a single click or step (the docs mention choosing release settings first), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish flow.
